'''Assistant Security Officer''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] rank used by the [[Tatooine militia|militia]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. [[Predne Balu]] held the rank during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MEAS">''[[Mos Eisley Adventure Set]]''</ref>
